verdict: Shared official planning backend and benchmark splits; not yet a controlled demonstration of particle-versus-register or intent-conditioned future information benefit.

matched.observation: Four current cameras F0/B0/L0/R0, one frame per camera, current ego11D
matched.optimizer: AdamW, base LR2e-4, weight decay0.01, official warmup/cosine convention
matched.lora_parameterization: Q/V rank32, scale1, pretrained weights frozen
matched.v2_training: Independent public init, official train membership, 10epochs, no longer target
matched.oracle_supervision: Original generated-proposal scoring labels, no direct object auxiliary loss

encoder_intent.drivor: No direct ego conditioning of DINO/register extraction
encoder_intent.lpwm: Command4D FiLM at particle CNN conv_in

distributed_partition.lpwm: 2 GPUs, batch16, accumulation2; first update used batch8 accumulation4

compression.lpwm: 64 native particles/camera, concatenate current+8predicted states, project and fixed mean groups of4

future_computation.lpwm: 8 prior steps; semantic time alignment remains unverified

differences.backend_initialization: Current LPWM planner constructed before the replacement backbone; a native DrivoR construction consumes RNG in a different order. Controlled runs must share an explicit backend initial state.

v1.status: Derived from repository drop_last and published4GPU recipe; not measured from an original author training log.

v2.status: Derived from repository drop_last and published4GPU recipe; not measured from an original author training log.

evaluation_version_requirement: Run both checkpoints through the same sealed NAVSIM commit, scorer config, full token set and v2 human-error filtering; paper number alone is not a paired baseline.
